evidence.exact_span: Relying on Dr Cunningham's evidence, Ranbaxy also submitted that there was a standard practice of representing the structure of a racemate, to the exclusion of the enantiomers, by depicting the enantiomer having the same absolute configuration as the naturally occurring substances (in this case compactin and mevinolin which are both active in the form of the 4R-trans enantiomer).
